shop/deployment/worker

Score calculation

   100  starting score
   -15  SR003 (caveat)  terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 300s, but Spot gives only 120s of notice
   -15  SR004 (caveat)  no topology spread or pod anti-affinity: replicas can land on the same node or zone
   -15  SR005 (caveat)  no PodDisruptionBudget: draining can remove too many replicas at once
   -15  SR006 (caveat)  container "worker" has no readinessProbe: traffic can reach a pod that is not ready
    -5  SR009 (info)  no preStop hook: in-flight requests may be cut when the node is reclaimed
  ------
    35  final score

  A blocker costs 50 points, a caveat 15 and an info 5.

Verdict: not-ready
  no blocker, but the caveats (SR003, SR004, SR005, SR006) took the score below 50, and that many caveats together are not "ready with caveats" any more

Confidence: high
  nothing the manifest cannot show lowers it

Spot flexibility: 100 (low constraints): any zone, any instance family
  It is separate from the score: only SR016 to SR019 affect the score.
